nodes.method: The 42 TEST records of research/2026-10-24/benches-r6/analysis-gpt-4.1-mini.r5-outcome-first-p1.json, replayed through calls' real ingest() and analyse() as the bench feeds them (judge off). The reply is rebuilt per record from its outcome, reason code and moment kinds, with quotes from the case's own lines. Then learning.propose reads them. product/tests/learning-r6.test.ts.
nodes.title: Learning's evidence reads the shipped analysis contract (r5-outcome-first) correctly: 42 of 42 calls store the recorded reason code, AI outcome read and moment kinds; every analysis prompt had OUTCOME before KIND; learning's counts equal the recorded ones; AI reads (more than 20 calls) never count as outcomes ({none: 42}). One leak found and fixed: an opt-out caller's line reached learning through the AI outcome read's quote.

Calls whose words never reach the model that writes the brief are crisis calls AND opted-out calls (reason, end reason, flag, or an opt_out moment). No line of theirs is quoted from a moment, a theme or an AI outcome read; the outcome read keeps only its value and calibration.
nodes.rationale: measure.2026-10-24.learning-reads-r6-contract: the outcome read carried an opt-out caller's line. In r6 the model also tags a crisis line as an objection (3 of 3 crisis records), so crisis calls must never be quoted from objections either.
nodes.reverse_if: Never for crisis. For opt-outs, only if the owner decides opted-out callers' words may train the brief.

nodes.title: Blueprint decision 9 is implemented: after every analysed live call, script.harm_check reads harm-class moments from what analysis stored, with no model call: complaint plus a request for a person, an ignored opt-out, a crisis without Tele-MANAS 14416 or 112, or a caller saying she lied. When 2 fall in any 15 consecutive live calls of one agent version, script_throttle slows its campaigns to 25% of their lines (gate G12, at least 1) and a critical Safety issue names the calls and quotes the moments. A crisis is quoted by her reply, never the caller's words. A member restores with one tap (script.pacing.restore, A1, audited); moments before a restore never re-throttle.
nodes.rationale: The must-be audit (research/2026-10-24/must-be-audit) found decision 9 contradicted: the only live fast lane was a 50-call early-hang-up rate monitor, and only experiment arms had a harm stop.
nodes.reverse_if: Real use shows the floor's wantsHuman or the lie pattern flag ordinary calls (measured as throttles a member restores within an hour with no change); then tighten that rule, never the window.

nodes.method: harmMoments over every analysis-bench case (scripts/analysis-bench/cases.ts, 72 Hinglish + 12 regional, synthetic), with each case's keyed moments, reason code, end reason and outcome.
nodes.title: Only the 6 complaint cases flag (complaint_human). None of the agreed, callback, not-interested, wrong-person, opt-out (the call ends on it), question, language-mismatch, crisis (she gives the line), early-hang-up, no-answer or objection-resolved cases flag.

events.details: Learning's evidence is checked against the shipped analysis contract with a fixture from 42 real r6 records (42/42; an opt-out-quote leak fixed). Blueprint decision 9's live fast lane is built: harm moments, a 15-call window, the 25% gate throttle, an issue with quotes, and a one-tap restore.
